key_insight: Combining infrared-feedback laser power control with simulation-guided external cooling sustained epitaxial CMSX-4 growth to nearly twice the build height achieved with process control alone.
engineering_relevance: Improved heat extraction enables taller single-crystal superalloy builds by L-DED, while optimized heat treatment reduces solutionizing time by 47%.
method: Dynamically adjust laser power using in-situ infrared thermal feedback.
Apply simulation-guided external cooling to stabilize solidification in cylindrical rods.
Optimize heat treatment and compare aged L-DED microstructures with Bridgman-processed samples.
evidence_signal: EBSD validated continuous single-crystal growth, near-constant primary dendrite arm spacing indicated steady solidification, and aged samples showed similar precipitate distributions across processing routes.
watch_item: The abstract demonstrates long cylindrical rods; scalability to complex geometries and resulting mechanical performance remain unestablished.
paper_title: Bulk CMSX-4 Single-Crystal Builds via Laser-Directed Energy Deposition: Epitaxial Stability and Microstructure Evolution
